data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableBackgroundApps.ShortDescription
data.value: Blocks Microsoft Store apps from running background tasks, reducing idle RAM use and background CPU wake-ups.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.LiftWebDavFileSizeLimit.ShortDescription
data.value: Raises the Windows WebClient transfer cap from 50 MB to 4 GB so large files stop failing on WebDAV network drives.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.KeyboardLatencyOptimization.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets keyboard repeat delay to the shortest interval and repeat rate to maximum for faster held-key input.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableAccessibilityKeyboardHotkeys.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables the keyboard shortcuts that pop up Sticky Keys, Filter Keys, and Toggle Keys when tapping or holding Shift or lock keys.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableHibernateAndFastStartup.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Fast Startup alone for clean cold boots, or disables Hibernation completely to reclaim gigabytes of disk space.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableUSBPowerSaving.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents Windows from powering down USB root hubs and connected peripherals, avoiding wake-up delays for mice, keyboards, and audio devices.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.InstallOptimizerDuckPowerPlan.ShortDescription
data.value: Installs and activates a custom high-performance power plan that keeps CPU cores responsive and reduces frequency scaling delays.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisablePowerSaving.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Windows Power Throttling so active and background apps run without CPU frequency throttling.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableTelemetry.ShortDescription
data.value: Minimizes Windows diagnostic data collection, app compatibility inventories, and feedback prompts.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableErrorReporting.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Windows Error Reporting and stops scheduled crash and disk diagnostic tasks from collecting or uploading failure reports.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableAdvertisingAndSuggestions.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off your Windows Advertising ID, diagnostic-based tailored experiences, consumer promotions, and setup suggestion prompts.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.HideMeetNowButton.ShortDescription
data.value: Hides the Meet Now button from the Windows 10 taskbar notification area.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableActivityHistory.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops Windows from publishing and uploading your app and file activity history to Microsoft.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableAutoLogger.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables non-essential Windows ETW diagnostic trace sessions at boot to cut background disk writes and CPU overhead.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableCortana.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off the Cortana assistant and blocks Windows Search from sending local desktop queries to cloud search on Windows 10.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableContentDeliveryManager.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops Windows from downloading lock screen Spotlight suggestions, system tips, and promoted consumer content in the background.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisablePreinstalledApps.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops Windows from silently downloading and pinning promoted consumer apps in the Start menu.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableUlps.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Ultra Low Power State (ULPS) on AMD GPUs to avoid wake-up stutters and multi-monitor flicker.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisablePowerGating.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off AMD GPU power gating and dynamic power-state scaling so graphics engines stay powered between burst workloads.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableAspm.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off PCIe Active State Power Management (L0s and L1) on AMD graphics adapters to reduce PCIe link wake-up latency.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.NvidiaDisableDynamicPstate.ShortDescription
data.value: Keeps NVIDIA GPUs from stepping into dynamic low-power P-states, avoiding downclocking transitions during light or burst workloads.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.NvidiaDisableAsyncPstates.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops NVIDIA drivers from switching performance states asynchronously during burst workloads for steadier frame pacing.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.IntelDisableAdaptiveVsync.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Intel driver-level adaptive V-Sync so graphics timing uses standard application or fixed sync behavior.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarWidgets.Recommendation.Reason

data.name: Customize.Preferences.CombineTaskbarButtons.Description

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerCompactMode.Description

data.name: Customize.Preferences.SnapAssistFlyout.Description
data.value: Shows or hides the Snap Layouts menu when you hover over a window's maximize button.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerItemCheckboxes.Description

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarTaskViewButton.Description
data.value: Shows or hides the Task View button on the taskbar.

data.value: Adds an End task command to the taskbar context menu, so you can close an unresponsive app without opening Task Manager.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarEndTask.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: End Task on the taskbar lets you kill frozen apps instantly without opening Task Manager.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.DarkMode.Description
data.value: Applies dark colors to Windows apps, Settings, and other shell elements.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerSyncNotifications.Description
data.value: Shows or hides notifications from OneDrive and other cloud sync providers in File Explorer.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerSyncNotifications.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Explorer Sync Notifications feature controls OneDrive and cloud-sync pop-ups while browsing files.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.SystemSuggestions.Description
data.value: Shows or hides Windows tips and app suggestions in Settings.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.SystemSuggestions.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The System Suggestions feature controls Windows recommendations for apps and settings.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ToastNotifications.Description
data.value: Controls toast notifications, including alerts that appear on the desktop or lock screen.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowFileExtensions.Description
data.value: Shows or hides file extensions such as .txt and .exe in File Explorer.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowFileExtensions.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: File extensions make suspicious file types easier to spot and prevent malware from hiding behind misleading icons.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowHiddenFiles.Description
data.value: Shows or hides hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowHiddenFiles.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Hidden files contain system and configuration data that may be needed for administration and troubleshooting.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClipboardHistory.Description
data.value: Keeps a history of copied items that you can browse with Win+V.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClipboardHistory.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Clipboard history lets you recall multiple past copies with Win+V, speeding up repetitive copy-paste workflows.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.WindowShake.Description
data.value: Shake the active window to minimize the others, or turn this behavior off.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClassicContextMenu.Description
data.value: Uses the classic Windows 10-style context menu instead of the condensed Windows 11 menu.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClassicContextMenu.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The classic menu shows all options at once without the extra click needed to expand Windows 11's condensed menu.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowSecondsInSystemClock.Description

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameMode.Description
data.value: Gives games priority for system resources and changes how Windows Update behaves while you play.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameMode.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Game Mode automatically prioritizes game processes and suspends Windows Update notifications while gaming for smoother performance.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameBar.Description
data.value: Shows the Xbox Game Bar and its related overlays and background features.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameBar.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Xbox Game Bar feature provides overlays and background gaming tools that may use system resources.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.BackgroundRecording.Description
data.value: Records gameplay and app activity in the background through Game DVR.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.BackgroundRecording.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Background Recording feature captures gameplay in the background, which can use CPU resources and create disk writes.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.MouseAcceleration.Description
data.value: Adjusts how cursor movement responds to the speed of your mouse.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.MouseAcceleration.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Mouse Acceleration feature changes cursor movement based on speed; raw linear input can improve aim consistency.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.FullscreenOptimizations.Description
data.value: Applies Windows' fullscreen optimizations, which can improve compatibility for some games.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.FullscreenOptimizations.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Disable it if you experience in-game stuttering, input lag, or black screens (especially in competitive shooters).

data.name: Customize.Gaming.HardwareAcceleratedGpuScheduling.Description
data.value: Lets the GPU handle more video-memory scheduling work. A compatible graphics driver is required.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.HardwareAcceleratedGpuScheduling.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: GPU scheduling offloads frame management from the CPU to the GPU, cutting display latency and improving frame pacing.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.DlssIndicator.Description
data.value: Controls the on-screen DLSS indicator overlay used to verify which DLSS version a game actually renders with.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.DlssIndicator.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: A diagnostic overlay; leave off unless you are checking DLSS behavior.

data.value: Lets compatible GPU drivers compose desktop and game planes directly in hardware. Disabling it can work around flickering or multi-monitor driver bugs.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.MultiPlaneOverlay.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Modern GPUs handle MPO efficiently for lower latency in borderless games; disable only if you experience screen flickering, black screens, or desktop composition glitches.

data.name: OptimizationDetailsDialog.GroupPolicyNotice
data.value: Applies standard Windows Group Policy settings. Some Windows Settings pages may display 'Some settings are managed by your organization' while active.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableAiServiceAutoStart.Name
data.value: Set AI Fabric Service to Manual

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableAiServiceAutoStart.ShortDescription
data.value: Switches the Windows AI Fabric background service to manual startup so it stays idle until an AI feature requests it.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableAiServiceAutoStart.TradeOff
data.value: Windows AI features that depend on this service may take a few seconds longer on first launch.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableEdgeAI.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables the Copilot sidebar, inline compose prompts, AI history search, and local AI models in Microsoft Edge.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableRecall.TradeOff
data.value: Disables Windows Recall timeline search and permanently removes saved snapshots.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableUnusedLegacyServices.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables legacy and enterprise services rarely needed on home PCs, including Fax, Remote Registry, Retail Demo, App-V, Routing and Remote Access, and switches Offline Files to manual.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableUnusedLegacyServices.TradeOff
data.value: Legacy faxing, Remote Registry, Routing and Remote Access, and App-V remain off until reverted; Offline Files only starts manually.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables selected Windows feature service groups you do not use, such as Printing, Bluetooth, Xbox, LAN Sharing, Biometrics, or Remote Desktop.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.TradeOff
data.value: Selected hardware or network features stay unavailable until you reconfigure or revert this optimization.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.NoSelection
data.value: No optional service groups were selected

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisablePrinting.Description
data.value: Stops the Print Spooler and printer notification background services.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisablePrinting.TradeOff
data.value: Local printers, network printers, and Microsoft Print to PDF will not work.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableBluetooth.Description
data.value: Stops Windows Bluetooth discovery, pairing, and hands-free audio services.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableBluetooth.TradeOff
data.value: Bluetooth keyboards, mice, controllers, and audio devices will stop connecting.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableXbox.Description
data.value: Stops Xbox Live sign-in, cloud save sync, accessory, and Xbox networking services.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableXbox.TradeOff
data.value: Xbox app sign-in, Game Pass cloud saves, and Xbox Live multiplayer stop working.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableLanSharing.Description
data.value: Stops local folder sharing and UPnP network device discovery services.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableLanSharing.TradeOff
data.value: Sharing local folders over LAN, SMB shares, and media casting discovery will stop working.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableBiometrics.Description
data.value: Stops the Windows Biometric background service.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableBiometrics.TradeOff
data.value: Fingerprint readers and Windows Hello face recognition will be disabled.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableRemoteDesktop.Description
data.value: Stops the incoming Remote Desktop connection and redirection services.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableOptionalFeatureServices.Option.DisableRemoteDesktop.TradeOff
data.value: Other PCs cannot connect to this computer via Remote Desktop (RDP).

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableSearchIndexing.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops the Windows Search indexer service to eliminate background disk writes and CPU spikes from file indexing.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableSearchIndexing.TradeOff
data.value: File-content searches in File Explorer and instant search in Outlook run slower because Windows must scan folders on demand.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableEdgeBackground.ShortDescription
data.value: Closes Microsoft Edge completely when its windows close and stops Startup Boost from preloading it at sign-in.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisableEdgeBackground.TradeOff
data.value: Cold-starting the first Edge window takes a moment longer, and site notifications pause once all Edge windows close.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableUlps.TradeOff
data.value: Idle graphics adapters and multi-GPU laptops consume more power when not under load.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisablePowerGating.TradeOff
data.value: Increases idle GPU power draw, heat, and fan speed, reducing laptop battery life.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableAspm.TradeOff
data.value: Keeps the GPU PCIe link out of low-power sleep states, raising idle power draw and battery drain.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.NvidiaDisableDynamicPstate.TradeOff
data.value: Increases idle GPU power draw, temperatures, and fan noise.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.NvidiaDisableAsyncPstates.TradeOff
data.value: Raises idle power draw on NVIDIA GPUs.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.IntelDisableAdaptiveVsync.TradeOff
data.value: Games or apps that drop below the monitor refresh rate may show occasional frame-time judder or screen tearing.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableBackgroundApps.TradeOff
data.value: Microsoft Store apps cannot sync mail, alarms, or live notifications in the background until opened manually.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.ConsolidateServiceHosts.TradeOff
data.value: Saves RAM on PCs with 12 GB or less, though a crash in one service can affect others sharing the same host process.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.KeyboardLatencyOptimization.TradeOff
data.value: Short repeat delay can trigger unintended duplicate letters if you hold keys slightly while typing.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableAccessibilityKeyboardHotkeys.TradeOff
data.value: Pressing Shift five times or holding NumLock will no longer trigger accessibility prompts; those tools remain available in Windows Settings.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableExplorerFolderDiscovery.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops File Explorer from scanning folder contents to guess specialized layouts such as Pictures or Music every time you open a folder.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableExplorerFolderDiscovery.TradeOff
data.value: Large image or music folders default to the standard Details view until you customize a folder view yourself.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableSearchWebView2.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops Windows 11 Search from spawning embedded Microsoft Edge WebView2 processes, cutting Search RAM and CPU use.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableSearchWebView2.TradeOff
data.value: Uses an internal Windows feature override that disables rich web cards in Search and may reset after major Windows updates.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableMemoryIntegrityHvci.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Windows Memory Integrity (HVCI) virtualization security checks to recover CPU performance and frame-time consistency in games.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableMemoryIntegrityHvci.TradeOff
data.value: Lowers Windows kernel protection against malicious drivers and code injection. Microsoft recommends turning it back on outside gaming.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableNicPowerSaving.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops Windows from powering down physical Ethernet and Wi-Fi adapters to save energy, preventing idle connection drops and wake-up lag.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableNicPowerSaving.TradeOff
data.value: Increases idle power draw on Ethernet and Wi-Fi, reducing laptop battery life.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableNicPowerSaving.NoAdapters
data.value: No configurable physical network adapters were found

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableHibernateAndFastStartup.TradeOff
data.value: Disabling hibernation removes automatic RAM-to-disk backup on critical battery loss; disabling Fast Startup makes cold starts slightly slower.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableHibernateAndFastStartup.Option.Mode.FastStartupOnly.Label
data.value: Disable Fast Startup Only (Recommended for Laptops)

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableHibernateAndFastStartup.Option.Mode.FastStartupOnly.Description
data.value: Stops Windows from saving a kernel hibernation snapshot at shutdown while keeping normal Hibernate intact.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableHibernateAndFastStartup.Option.Mode.DisableAll.Description
data.value: Turns off hibernation completely and deletes the hibernation file to reclaim several gigabytes of storage.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableModernStandbyNetworking.ShortDescription
data.value: Disconnects Wi-Fi and stops background network wakes while your laptop sleeps in Modern Standby.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableModernStandbyNetworking.TradeOff
data.value: While sleeping, apps wait until you wake the device before syncing email, updates, or push notifications.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableUSBPowerSaving.TradeOff
data.value: USB hubs and plugged-in devices stay powered instead of entering Selective Suspend, slightly lowering laptop battery life.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.InstallOptimizerDuckPowerPlan.TradeOff
data.value: Keeping CPU cores unparked increases heat, fan speed, and power draw; Task Manager may read higher CPU utilization than actual load on some systems.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisablePowerSaving.TradeOff
data.value: Background tasks can run at full CPU speed even on battery, increasing heat and battery drain.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableTelemetry.TradeOff
data.value: Microsoft diagnostics, Windows Insider flighting, and tailored troubleshooting feedback are disabled.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableErrorReporting.TradeOff
data.value: Application crashes no longer generate or upload diagnostic reports to Microsoft.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableAutoLogger.TradeOff
data.value: Turns off low-level diagnostic traces used for Microsoft troubleshooting; some security suites may alert on boot trace changes.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableFindMyDevice.TradeOff
data.value: You cannot locate or lock this PC remotely from your Microsoft account dashboard if it is lost or stolen.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.ShortDescription
data.value: Applies selected Windows Update Group Policies to control forced restarts, preview rollouts, update deferrals, and driver updates.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.TradeOff
data.value: Deferring updates or excluding Driver updates delays non-critical patches and requires updating GPU or chipset drivers manually.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.NoSelection
data.value: No Windows Update options were selected

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.PreventAutoReboot.Label
data.value: Prevent automatic reboot while signed in

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.PreventAutoReboot.Description
data.value: Stops Windows Update from restarting automatically while you are signed in.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DisableUpdateAsap.Label
data.value: Opt out of 'Get the latest updates as soon as they're available'

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DisableUpdateAsap.Description
data.value: Opts out of early preview feature and configuration rollouts when checking for updates.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DisableDriverUpdates.Label
data.value: Exclude driver updates from Windows Update

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DisableDriverUpdates.Description
data.value: Excludes hardware driver packages from Windows Update.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DisableDriverUpdates.TradeOff
data.value: You must install and update hardware drivers directly from GPU/OEM installers.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DeferUpdates.Label
data.value: Defer quality (4 days) and feature updates (365 days)

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DeferUpdates.Description
data.value: Applies Group Policy deferral windows to give patches time to mature before installation.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.ConfigureWindowsUpdate.Option.DeferUpdates.TradeOff
data.value: Delays monthly quality patches by 4 days and major annual Windows feature upgrades by 1 year.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableBitLockerAutoEncryption.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents Windows from automatically turning on BitLocker Device Encryption on new or reinstalled drives.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableBitLockerAutoEncryption.TradeOff
data.value: Does not decrypt already-encrypted drives, and leaves future drives unencrypted at rest unless you enable BitLocker manually.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableEdgeAI.TradeOff
data.value: Copilot sidebar, AI writing assistance, and AI history search become unavailable in Microsoft Edge.

data.name: Optimizer.Legacy.ClearRecord.Tooltip
data.value: Delete this saved backup without changing Windows settings

data.name: Optimizer.Legacy.ClearRecord.Confirm
data.value: Delete this saved backup without changing Windows? You will no longer be able to revert these older changes through optimizerDuck.

data.name: Optimizer.Legacy.EmptyDescription
data.value: Every retired optimization backup has been reverted or cleared.

data.name: Optimizer.Options.AllOffWillRevert
data.value: All options are off. Confirming will revert this optimization to its previous state.

data.name: Optimizer.Options.AlreadySet.Tooltip
data.value: Your system already matches this option, so no changes are needed.

data.name: Optimizer.Options.AllAlreadySet
data.value: Every option here is already configured on your system. Nothing needs to be changed.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisablePaintAI.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables Cocreator, Generative Fill, Image Creator, Generative Erase, and AI background removal policies in Windows Paint.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisablePaintAI.TradeOff
data.value: AI image generation and editing tools are removed from Windows Paint toolbars.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableNotepadAI.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables AI text rewriting and summarization features inside Windows Notepad via policy.

data.name: Optimizer.AI.DisableNotepadAI.TradeOff
data.value: AI Rewrite and summarization actions become unavailable inside Windows Notepad.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableCompatibilityAssistant.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables the Windows Program Compatibility Assistant service that monitors app launches and legacy installers in the background.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableCompatibilityAssistant.TradeOff
data.value: Automatic compatibility warnings and fallback shims for older programs and installers are disabled.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableTypingAndInkingPersonalization.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops Windows from collecting handwriting, typing patterns, local contacts, and user profile language preferences for input personalization.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableTypingAndInkingPersonalization.TradeOff
data.value: Custom handwriting recognition, contact-based autocorrect, and local typing dictionary learning stop updating.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableLocationTracking.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables the Windows Location service, app location consent, offline Maps auto-updates, and Wi-Fi hotspot reporting.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableLocationTracking.TradeOff
data.value: Weather, Maps, and apps that rely on system location cannot determine your position while active.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableHardwareSensors.ShortDescription
data.value: Blocks apps and Windows features from reading motion, orientation, and ambient light sensors via Group Policy.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableHardwareSensors.TradeOff
data.value: Laptop auto-brightness and automatic screen rotation on 2-in-1 devices stop working while active.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableExplorerStartupDelay.ShortDescription
data.value: Removes Explorer's built-in sign-in delay and CPU-idle wait so startup programs launch immediately after login.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.ReduceMenuShowDelay.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets Windows' cascading menu hover delay to zero so submenus open immediately under your pointer.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableVisualEffects.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables taskbar animations, listview shadows, window transparency, and Aero Peek to free up GPU/CPU resources for better performance.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableStartMenuWebSearch.ShortDescription
data.value: Turn off web search for Windows Start Menu to load the local search results faster.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableNewsAndInterests.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off the News and Interests feed and hides its taskbar button (Windows 10), and disables the Widgets board (Windows 11).

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.ProcessPriority.ShortDescription
data.value: Allocates more CPU resources to the application you are currently using for a faster, more responsive experience.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.OptimizeMultimediaScheduler.ShortDescription
data.value: Configures the Multimedia Class Scheduler Service (MMCSS) for gaming and low latency by prioritizing multimedia workloads and disabling network throttling.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.MaximizeUpdatePauseLimit.ShortDescription
data.value: Extends the Windows Update pause limit to 10 years (520 weeks) in Windows Settings.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableVideoClockGating.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables power and clock gating on AMD video encode and decode engines (VCE/UVD) to improve playback and recording stability.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.IntelDisableAsyncFlips.ShortDescription
data.value: Forces synchronous display buffer flips on Intel integrated GPUs to reduce input latency and screen tearing.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableVisualEffects.TradeOff
data.value: Removes taskbar animations, window transparency, Aero Peek, and icon shadows.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableStartMenuWebSearch.TradeOff
data.value: Web results and online suggestions will no longer appear in Start menu search.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.MaximizeUpdatePauseLimit.TradeOff
data.value: Security and quality updates remain paused for as long as you choose to defer them in Windows Settings.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableNewsAndInterests.TradeOff
data.value: Hides the News and Interests feed on Windows 10 and disables the Widgets board on Windows 11.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.OptimizeMultimediaScheduler.TradeOff
data.value: May increase background CPU usage and power consumption on laptops.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableVideoClockGating.TradeOff
data.value: AMD GPUs draw more power during video playback and hardware encoding.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.IntelDisableAsyncFlips.TradeOff
data.value: May limit uncapped frame rates or change frame pacing in some games on Intel GPUs.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableDiagnosticAutoLoggers.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables the Windows Diagnostics Infrastructure real-time trace sessions (DiagLog and WdiContextLog) at boot to reduce background diagnostic overhead.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableDiagnosticAutoLoggers.TradeOff
data.value: Prevents the Diagnostic Policy Service from loading SRUM, causing Task Manager's per-process Network column to show 0 Mbps and breaking App History, Data Usage stats, battery reports, and Windows Troubleshooters until reverted and restarted.
